create_HMCProposer: create an HMCProposer instance with an initial world, target RVs, trajectory length, and step size parameters
propose_HMCProposer: propose a new world state from the current world using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo leapfrog integration
do_adaptation_HMCProposer: adapt the step size and mass matrix using dual averaging based on the last accept probability
finish_adaptation_HMCProposer: finalize step size adaptation by calling the dual average adapter finalize method
review_HMCProposer_leapfrog: review the leapfrog integration step method that performs velocity Verlet integration for HMC sampling
